intro: IHOP (the International House of Pancakes) is the all-day breakfast chain famous for its Original Buttermilk Pancakes, big combo plates like the Breakfast Sampler and 2x2x2, omelettes, Thick 'N Fluffy French Toast, crepes and, since it added lunch and dinner, Steakburgers. Pancakes come as a short or full stack, and the whole menu runs 24 hours at many locations. Below is the full IHOP menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A short stack of IHOP Original Buttermilk Pancakes is about $8.99 and a full stack is $11.99. The Breakfast Sampler is $10.59, a 2x2x2 combo is $10.99, and omelettes run $14.99 to $16.99. A Steakburger is $14.99. The buttermilk pancakes are the signature. A full stack is about 820 calories.
hot_deal: IHOP value: the House Faves 2x2x2 (about $6.00) is the cheapest full breakfast, and kids eat cheap with pancake combos from $5.49. The International Bank of Pancakes app rewards program and regular 'all you can eat pancakes' promotions add value. Family Feasts (about $29.99) feed four to go. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much are pancakes at IHOP?
faqs.a: A short stack of Original Buttermilk Pancakes is about $8.99 and a full stack is $11.99. Flavored stacks like Double Blueberry or Chocolate Chip are around $12.99. Combos that add eggs and meat start at about $6.00 for the House Faves 2x2x2.

faqs.q: Does IHOP serve breakfast all day?
faqs.a: Yes. IHOP serves its full breakfast menu, including pancakes, all day and all night at many locations, which run 24 hours. It also has a lunch and dinner menu with burgers, chicken and dinner plates.

The 2x2x2 is IHOP's classic combo: two eggs, two strips of bacon or sausage links, and two buttermilk pancakes, for about $10.99. The cheaper House Faves version is around $6.00, the best value full breakfast.

faqs.q: How many calories are in IHOP pancakes?
faqs.a: A full stack of five Original Buttermilk Pancakes is about 820 calories before syrup, roughly 164 per pancake. A Big Steak Omelette is about 770 and a Classic Burger about 740. Syrup and butter add more.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at IHOP?
faqs.a: The best known are the Original Buttermilk Pancakes, the Breakfast Sampler, the 2x2x2 combo, the Big Steak Omelette, and the Thick 'N Fluffy French Toast.
